rumCesarion1: Dock rumor: "Cesarion never leaves his scrap throne. They say he keeps a Nexus Fragment under his seat — and kills anyone who looks too closely."
rumRaphazarus1: A smuggler lowers his voice: "Raphazarus sends his warriors after anyone who touches the Fragments. If you're looking for the Nexus, he'll end up looking for you."
rumEliotis1: An archivist scribbles in her notebook: "Eliotis collects truths more than gold. Bring her a lore fragment and she'll open doors no one else knows about."
rumMaxance1: Two mercenaries speak low: "Maxance would rather burn a secret than share it. Watch out — what he destroys, no one sees again."
rumAlanossa1: A merchant stares you down: "Alanossa holds the West Arc with an iron fist. Word is she keeps one of the Nexus Fragments. Stay on her good side... or not at all."
rumScotty1: A drunk pilot laughs: "Scotty? That old fox from Golden North would sell his mother for a good deal. Even a Nexus Fragment, if the price is right."
rumCesarion2: Fresh graffiti on a bulkhead: 'CESARION WATCHES'. Someone scrawled underneath, in a hurry: 'and he knows about the Fragments'.
rumAlanossa2: A corridor kid recites a rhyme: "Alanossa, Alanossa, betray her and pay twice..." She runs off before you can ask a single question.
